hello: Hello, here you can design your cake
mainDescription1: Dreaming of a special cake but can't explain to the baker exactly what you want? Our Cake Designer is your magic wand in the world of sweets!
mainDescription2: Here you can bring to life your boldest confectionery fantasies: round, square, or unicorn-shaped? Light as a cloud or a monumental 5 kg masterpiece? One tier or an entire confectionery skyscraper?
mainDescription3: Choose a recipe that will make your taste buds dance with joy — from classic Napoleon to trendy Red Velvet. Coating for any taste: delicate fondant, glossy mirror glaze, or fluffy cream.
mainDescription4: Add a special touch to your creation! Figurines of favorite characters, edible flowers, sparkling candles, messages with wishes — everything is in your hands!
mainDescription5: Done? Save the template and send your sweet masterpiece's detailed plan to the baker. And if you get confused — check out the video instructions right here
